name: v1.261.0
body:
## What's Changed
* Switch to ignoring semver-minor updates by @alexcrichton in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2710
* Bump actions/setup-node from 4 to 7 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2712
* Ignore semver-patch updates in dependabot by @alexcrichton in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2716
* wit-parser: reject duplicate record fields, flags and cases by @youdie006 in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2698
* wasm-wave: Upgrade logos to 0.16.1 by @lann in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2718
* wit-parser: reject flags with more than 32 members by @youdie006 in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2719
* Fix some issues validating custom sections by @alexcrichton in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2720
* Fix incremental parsing of component `start` section by @alexcrichton in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2722
* Fix `read_var_s33` and handling in component defined types by @alexcrichton in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2723
* Reject truncated nested modules and components by @alexcrichton in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2724
* Fix validation of the key types of `map` by @alexcrichton in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2725
* Tighten some feature gates in `wasmparser` by @alexcrichton in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2721
* Fix disallowing borrows in streams/futures/values by @alexcrichton in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2727
* Fix some custom-descriptors validation of dead code by @alexcrichton in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2734
* Limit total components/modules in validation by @alexcrichton in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2730
* Fix validation of tags in components by @alexcrichton in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2741
* Release wasm-tools 1.261.0 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2738
* fix incorrect async callback validation by @alexcrichton in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2742


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/compare/v1.260.0...v1.261.0
